mapper.sql: FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots k ON k.employee_no = u.employee_no

a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, COALESCE(k.name, u.login_id) AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, d.performance_content, d.academic_year, CAST(d.semester_code AS integer) AS semester, a.attachment_ids, a.created_at, a.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-031' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a, d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements a WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-031' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.setting_id FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.evaluation_year = #{year} AND p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.setting_id FOR SHARE

SELECT c.code_value AS value, c.code_name AS label FROM detail_codes c JOIN code_groups g ON g.group_id = c.group_id WHERE c.group_id = #{groupId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND (c.valid_start_date IS NULL OR c.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (c.valid_end_date IS NULL OR c.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.code_value

SELECT m.management_item_code, m.management_item_name, m.required_yn, m.data_type, m.teacher_editable_yn FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_rule_versions v ON v.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id WHERE m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND e.element_code = 'FR-031' AND v.version_status = 'CONFIRMED'
AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND CAST(CONCAT(#{year}, '-12-31') AS date) >= v.effective_start_date AND CAST(CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01') AS date) <= v.effective_end_date
ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.management_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, performance_content, academic_year, semester_code ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{request.achievementContent}, #{request.academicYear}, CAST(#{request.semester} AS varchar) )
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements a SET management_item_code = #{request.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{request.achievementDate}, achievement_detail = CAST(#{detailJson} AS jsonb), attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentsJson} AS jsonb), updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-031' AND a.teacher_user_id = #{userId} AND a.achievement_status = 'DRAFT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_finalizations f WHERE f.target_user_id = a.teacher_user_id AND f.evaluation_year = a.evaluation_year AND f.final_status = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' )

UPDATE lecture_improvement_achievement_details SET performance_content = #{request.achievementContent}, academic_year = #{request.academicYear}, semester_code = CAST(#{request.semester} AS varchar) WHERE achievement_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('achievement', TO_JSONB(a), 'detail', TO_JSONB(d))::text FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-031'
mapper.insert:
